from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
prog = '''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0 = min(y for y,x in cells); r1 = max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y,x in cells); c1 = max(x for y,x in cells)
            rh, cw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
            cellset = set(cells)
            # A 3x3 square acts as a marked symbol: its center becomes 7.
            if rh == 3 and cw == 3 and all((y,x) in cellset for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)):
                out[r0+1][c0+1] = 7
                continue
            if rh < 3 or cw < 3:
                continue
            border = {(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)
                      if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            if not border.issubset(cellset):
                continue
            # Fill the hollow rectangle. Odd-by-odd interior gets 7; otherwise 2.
            fill = 7 if (rh-2) % 2 == 1 and (cw-2) % 2 == 1 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
